answer_rationale: Text 1 and Text 8 explicitly mention that 349 sentences were read in a normal reading paradigm, distinguishing it from the task-specific reading paradigm. This indicates that a normal reading paradigm refers to reading without a specific annotation or task, allowing natural reading behavior.
